name: an authenticated call is relayed to the upstream verbatim
description: On success the gateway is a pass-through: it relays the caller's request to {upstream}/api/{method} and copies the upstream status, headers and body back byte-for-byte. That upstream body is already the Conduit envelope {result, error_code, error_info}, so the gateway must not wrap or rewrite it. This fixture asserts the relayed shape; the runner points the gateway's proxy at a stub upstream that answers a fixed Conduit success body, described in the conduit contract README, because the contract runner has no live Phorge to reach.
